title: channel.py:75: OverflowError on negative or large seed value
description: seed.to_bytes(4, 'little') raises OverflowError if seed < 0 or seed >= 2^32. The seed parameter comes from GnssHopConfig with no validation. Fix: Validate seed at config creation: 0 <= seed < 2^32, or mask it: (seed & 0xFFFFFFFF).to_bytes(4, 'little')
